messages.author: f89d9e15b9f79463
messages.subject: geom_bar with negative y
parts:
hi everyone

here's my problem:

d<-data.frame(l=rep(1:5,5),a=rep(1:5,rep(5,5)),v=rnorm(25))
ggplot(aes(x=factor(l), y=v, fill=factor(a)),data=d)+geom_bar()

produces

Warning message:
Stacking not well defined when ymin != 0

even though "stacking not well defined", the graph doesn't make sense because some of the bars straddle zero.  what id like is for the negative bars to all stack downwards below the x-axis, stacking each on the bottom of the next, and the positive bars to likewise stack up on top of each other above the x-axis as typical for a positive dataset.

i tried sorting first, but no dice:

f<-function(x) { return(x[order(x[,3]),]) }
dord<-ddply(d, .(l), f)
ggplot(aes(x=factor(l), y=v, fill=factor(a)),data=dord)+geom_bar()

any help would be greatly appreciated!

thanks
-neal
